data: EquipmentCatalog in-memory dict mapping equipment_id to status string
LoanService in-memory dict mapping loan_id to record with loan_id, equipment_id, status
History list of record snapshots returned by LoanService.history
Summary dict with total, reserved, checked_out, returned, cancelled integer fields
concurrency: Single-process in-memory only; no concurrent scheduling or cross-process state sharing per out_of_scope.
interaction: LoanService calls injected EquipmentCatalog for claim and release; LoanReport consumes history list only.
decisions: Pure Python single-process memory; no web, network services, DB, or disk persistence per out_of_scope
No login, real-name, billing, or expiry reminders per out_of_scope
Uniform dict return: {ok:true,data:value} on success, {ok:false,error:{code:code}} on failure
Seven delivery tasks: three implementation, three unit test, one integration acceptance

elements.description: EquipmentCatalog.register adds equipment_id with AVAILABLE status
elements.acceptance_method: Assert register('CAM-1') returns {ok:true,data:{equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'AVAILABLE'}}

elements.description: EquipmentCatalog.get_equipment returns current status snapshot
elements.acceptance_method: Assert get_equipment('CAM-1') returns {ok:true,data:{equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'AVAILABLE'}}

elements.description: Repeated register of same equipment_id reports DUPLICATE
elements.acceptance_method: Assert second register('CAM-1') returns {ok:false,error:{code:'DUPLICATE'}}

elements.description: Operations on unknown equipment_id report NOT_FOUND
elements.acceptance_method: Assert get_equipment, claim, release on 'UNKNOWN' return {ok:false,error:{code:'NOT_FOUND'}}

elements.description: Equipment IDs are case-sensitive
elements.acceptance_method: Assert register('cam-1') succeeds independently from 'CAM-1' without DUPLICATE

elements.description: EquipmentCatalog.claim transitions equipment to UNAVAILABLE
elements.acceptance_method: Assert claim('CAM-1') returns {ok:true,data:{equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'UNAVAILABLE'}}

elements.description: EquipmentCatalog.release transitions equipment to AVAILABLE
elements.acceptance_method: Assert release('CAM-1') returns {ok:true,data:{equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'AVAILABLE'}}

elements.description: Claiming already claimed equipment reports UNAVAILABLE
elements.acceptance_method: Assert claim on UNAVAILABLE equipment returns {ok:false,error:{code:'UNAVAILABLE'}}

elements.description: Releasing unclaimed equipment reports INVALID_TRANSITION
elements.acceptance_method: Assert release on AVAILABLE equipment returns {ok:false,error:{code:'INVALID_TRANSITION'}}

elements.description: Failed claim or release leaves state unchanged
elements.acceptance_method: Assert status before and after failed claim/release remains identical

elements.description: LoanService.reserve claims via catalog and creates RESERVED record
elements.acceptance_method: Assert reserve('L1','CAM-1') returns {ok:true,data:{loan_id:'L1',equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'RESERVED'}}

elements.description: Retrying reserve with same loan_id and equipment_id returns current status
elements.acceptance_method: Assert repeated reserve('L1','CAM-1') returns {ok:true,data:{loan_id:'L1',equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'RESERVED'}}

elements.description: Reserving different equipment under existing loan_id reports CONFLICT
elements.acceptance_method: Assert reserve('L1','CAM-2') returns {ok:false,error:{code:'CONFLICT'}}

elements.description: Reserving unknown equipment reports NOT_FOUND
elements.acceptance_method: Assert reserve('L2','UNKNOWN') returns {ok:false,error:{code:'NOT_FOUND'}}

elements.description: Reserving already claimed equipment reports UNAVAILABLE
elements.acceptance_method: Assert reserve on UNAVAILABLE equipment returns {ok:false,error:{code:'UNAVAILABLE'}}

elements.description: Failed reserve does not add a loan record
elements.acceptance_method: Assert history after failed reserve contains no new records

elements.description: LoanService.checkout transitions RESERVED to CHECKED_OUT
elements.acceptance_method: Assert checkout('L1') returns {ok:true,data:{loan_id:'L1',equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'CHECKED_OUT'}}

elements.description: LoanService.return_equipment transitions CHECKED_OUT to RETURNED and releases catalog
elements.acceptance_method: Assert return_equipment('L1') returns {ok:true,data:{loan_id:'L1',equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'RETURNED'}}

elements.description: LoanService.cancel transitions RESERVED to CANCELLED and releases catalog
elements.acceptance_method: Assert cancel('L1') returns {ok:true,data:{loan_id:'L1',equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'CANCELLED'}}

elements.description: Catalog remains UNAVAILABLE after checkout until return or cancel
elements.acceptance_method: Assert catalog.get_equipment shows UNAVAILABLE after checkout, AVAILABLE after return/cancel

elements.description: Invalid state transitions report INVALID_TRANSITION
elements.acceptance_method: Assert checkout on RETURNED returns {ok:false,error:{code:'INVALID_TRANSITION'}}

elements.description: Operations on unknown loan_id report NOT_FOUND
elements.acceptance_method: Assert checkout/return/cancel on 'UNKNOWN' returns {ok:false,error:{code:'NOT_FOUND'}}

elements.description: LoanService.history returns all records for equipment in reservation order
elements.acceptance_method: Assert history('CAM-1') returns list of dicts each with loan_id, equipment_id, status

elements.description: History for registered equipment with no records returns empty list
elements.acceptance_method: Assert history('CAM-1') returns {ok:true,data:[]} when no loans exist

elements.description: History for unknown equipment reports NOT_FOUND
elements.acceptance_method: Assert history('UNKNOWN') returns {ok:false,error:{code:'NOT_FOUND'}}

elements.description: Modifying returned records does not affect subsequent queries; other equipment excluded
elements.acceptance_method: Assert mutating result list does not change next history call; CAM-2 records absent from CAM-1

elements.description: LoanReport.summarize counts statuses into total, reserved, checked_out, returned, cancelled
elements.acceptance_method: Assert summarize with one of each status returns data.total=4, reserved=1, checked_out=1, returned=1, cancelled=1

elements.description: Summarize with empty list returns all zero fields
elements.acceptance_method: Assert summarize([]) returns {ok:true,data:{total:0,reserved:0,checked_out:0,returned:0,cancelled:0}}

elements.description: Summarize does not modify input records list
elements.acceptance_method: Assert input list identity and contents unchanged after summarize call

elements.description: LoanReport can run independently with same-shape data
elements.acceptance_method: Assert summarize accepts plain list of dicts matching history shape without LoanService

elements.description: Empty or non-string equipment_id or loan_id reports INVALID_ARGUMENT
elements.acceptance_method: Assert methods with '' or 123 as ID return {ok:false,error:{code:'INVALID_ARGUMENT'}}

elements.description: Any failure does not change internal state
elements.acceptance_method: Assert state snapshots before and after any failing call remain equal

elements.description: Two independent catalog and loan instances do not share data
elements.acceptance_method: Assert operations on instance A do not affect instance B state or history
